title: The Ling Guang APP Launches One-Click Deployment: Supports Direct Publication of AI Applications such as Codex, Claude Code, and Cursor
excerpt: Recently, the Lingguang App launched the "One-Click Deployment" feature for flash applications and made it available to all users. Applications created by users
content_html:
Recently, the Lingguang App launched the "One-Click Deployment" feature for flash applications and made it available to all users. Applications created by users using mainstream AI tools such as Codex, Claude Code, Cursor, Qoder, Trae, and Workbuddy can be published as "Lingguang Flash Applications" through the deployment Skill provided by Lingguang, and will be displayed and distributed on both the PC version and the Lingguang App. At the same time, Lingguang also opened more than 30 free API capabilities, including large models, search, LBS, maps, and storage, helping users quickly complete application function setup.

Starting today, users can log in to the Lingguang App official website, enter the [Settings - Use Lingguang Skill] page on the PC, complete simple steps such as Alipay authentication and Lingguang Skill deployment, and then experience the "One-Click Deployment" feature of the Lingguang Flash Application, achieving fast publication from concept to application launch.

With the rapid development of AIGC technology, AI-assisted programming is significantly improving development efficiency. However, for many creators, converting an "AI-generated application prototype" into a "real application that is online" still requires handling complex processes such as server deployment, environment configuration, and multi-terminal adaptation. The "One-Click Deployment" feature that Lingguang has now opened aims to further lower the threshold for AI application productization and complete the entire process from generation, deployment, to distribution of AI applications.

According to the information, the biggest feature of this deployment function lies in "seamless connection" and "extreme simplification." Developers do not need to switch workflows or perform complex code migration. After completing application development in third-party AI tools, they only need to use the Skill instructions and scaffolding capabilities provided by Lingguang to automatically complete application adaptation, packaging, and deployment, and publish it as a Lingguang Flash Application. This entire process does not require self-configuring servers, domains, or maintenance environments, truly realizing "publish immediately after development."

Currently, the "One-Click Deployment" of Lingguang Flash Applications supports both creating new applications from scratch and quickly migrating existing Web applications to Lingguang. After deployment, the application will be automatically synchronized to "My Creations," and the system will also generate a preview QR code. Users can view, debug, and optimize the application in real-time on both the Lingguang PC and the Lingguang App, achieving synchronization between two ends and ensuring a consistent user experience.

More importantly, Lingguang also opens up more than 30 free API capabilities, including large models, search, camera, persistent storage, gyroscope, AIGC, location, real-time voice recognition, 3D scene animation, and other end-to-end services. Users can freely call these underlying capabilities to add more rich features to their flash applications.

In addition, all flash applications that pass review can be published in the "Lingguang Circle" community within the Lingguang App, receiving recommendations and traffic support from the Lingguang platform, helping high-quality applications quickly gain initial users and exposure.

It is worth mentioning that this feature also provides strong support for the "Outer Bank Hackathon · AI Coding Competition." Whether participants use any mainstream AI coding tool, after completing development, they can instantly deploy their work as a Lingguang Flash Application and directly submit it as a work in the Lingguang track, further simplifying the competition process.

content_html_zh:
近日，灵光App推出Flash应用“一键部署”功能，并向所有用户开放。 用户使用Codex、Claude Code、Cursor、Qoder、Trae、Workbuddy等主流AI工具创建的应用程序，可以通过灵光提供的部署Skill发布为“灵光Flash应用”，并在PC版和灵光App上同时展示和分发。 同时，灵光还开放了30多个免费API能力，包括大模型、搜索、LBS、地图、存储等，帮助用户快速完成应用功能设置。

即日起，用户可登录灵光App官网，在PC端进入【设置-使用灵光技能】页面，完成支付宝认证、灵光技能部署等简单步骤，即可体验灵光Flash应用的“一键部署”功能，实现从概念发布到应用上线的快速发布。

随着AIGC技术的快速发展，AI辅助编程正在显着提高开发效率。 但对于很多创作者来说，将“AI生成的应用原型”转化为“上线的真实应用”，仍然需要处理服务器部署、环境配置、多终端适配等复杂流程。 灵光此次开启的“一键部署”功能，旨在进一步降低AI应用产品化门槛，完成AI应用从生成、部署到分发的全流程。

据了解，该部署功能最大的特点在于“无缝连接”和“极度简化”。 开发人员无需切换工作流程或进行复杂的代码迁移。 在第三方AI工具中完成应用开发后，只需利用灵光提供的Skill指令和脚手架能力，即可自动完成应用适配、打包和部署，并发布为灵光Flash应用。 整个过程不需要自行配置服务器、域、维护环境，真正实现“开发后立即发布”。

目前，灵光Flash应用的“一键部署”既支持从头开始创建新应用，也支持将现有Web应用快速迁移到灵光。 部署完成后，应用会自动同步到“我的创作”，系统还会生成预览二维码。 用户可以在灵光PC和灵光App上实时查看、调试和优化应用程序，实现两端同步，保证用户体验一致。

更重要的是，灵光还开放了30多个免费API能力，包括大模型、搜索、摄像头、持久存储、陀螺仪、AIGC、位置、实时语音识别、3D场景动画等端到端服务。 用户可以自由调用这些底层能力，为自己的Flash应用添加更多丰富的功能。

此外，所有通过审核的Flash应用都可以发布在灵光App内的“灵光圈”社区，接受灵光平台的推荐和流量支持，帮助优质应用快速获得初始用户和曝光。

值得一提的是，该功能还为“外行黑客马拉松·AI编码大赛”提供了有力支持。 无论参赛者使用任何主流AI编码工具，完成开发后，都可以立即将作品部署为灵光Flash应用程序，并直接将其作为作品提交到灵光赛道，进一步简化了比赛流程。
